name: Onna Gari
source:
My name is Inusuke Karitani, and I work as a coach at the local university. These days, the daily exercises are... just plain don't matter to me anymore. The night is my time of day. It's the time when I give in to my wild instincts... and head out to hunt! I hunt the hard-working female teachers, the little human brats, and the cheeky karate girls.

I corner them, strike fear into their hearts, and then I hold them down!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ042064.html]DLsite English[/url]]
